# Evolution24 Properties

> Family-owned property management company, founded 2024, with apartments in Rochester, Syracuse, Manlius and Geneva, New York.

## Contact
- Office: 176 N Water Street, Rochester, NY 14604
- Phone: 585-759-7117
- Email: tesacoleman9@gmail.com
- Residents pay rent and request maintenance at https://evolution.twa.rentmanager.com/
- Pets: up to two per apartment; $300 non-refundable deposit and $45 a month per pet.
- Rent is paid by check, money order or online. Cash is not accepted.
